apis_reused: Existing RSVP, registration, duty, ticket, pass, check-in, certificate and export APIs
api_extension: Owner-only DELETE /event-filters/{id} supports removing saved filters and event bookmarks.
database_changes: No new tables or event migrations. Existing production event records preserved. Regression mutations ran in clubs_test only.
definitions: Discovery KPIs cover the authorized filtered range independently of cursor pagination.
Report date range selects event start dates. Registration timelines use registration creation dates within those event cohorts.
Previous cohort dates are shifted by the selected period length for visual comparison.
Attendance counts distinct primary registration event check-ins, excluding voided and session check-ins. Companions are seats.
Funnel confirmed and attended stages include registrations linked to responded invitations; uninvited open registrations are excluded.
Verified volunteer hours cover all programs and are explicitly labeled accordingly.
security: Report filters intersect authorized organization descendants.
Personal identity comes from the authenticated session.
Saved filters and bookmarks are private to their owner.
Existing independent approval, CSRF, capacity locking, consent, pass revocation and QR verification remain in use.
remaining_limitations: Paid registration and WhatsApp remain disabled without their provider integrations.
Aggregate report export is JSON; existing per-event attendance CSV and secure pass/badge PDF exports remain available.

Bookmarks share the existing limit of 30 saved filters per user. Personal calendar queries are bounded to 500 records per type and one year per request. The duty inbox retains its existing 50-row bound.
State-level geography, host feedback aggregation and separate late-cancellation analytics are not added. Existing per-event feedback and audit workflows remain available.
No new 10,000-event load benchmark was run for the expanded aggregate queries.
